answer_1.quote: We assess the usefulness of state-of-the-art NMT in professional translation... Three translation modalities were adopted: human translation from scratch (HT), post-editing of Google Translate's translation (PE1), and post-editing of mBART-50's translation (PE2).
answer_1.outputs: source sentences, human translations, machine translations, post-edited translations

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation of NMT systems... BLEU, CHRF, COMET, HTER, CharacTER were computed...

answer_4.quote: We collect three types of data: ... The latter elicits subjective assessments of post-editing quality, effort and enjoyability compared to translating from scratch. ... participants expressed their perception of MT quality and translation speed across HT and PE modalities using a 1-7 Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated MT adequacy, fluency, overall quality, enjoyability and speed on a 1-7 Likert scale (post‑task questionnaire).
